answer: Resist sybils with meter-bound identities: each agent binds its identity to one distinct electricity meter, submitting a signed consumption reading every epoch, like a trellis that only holds one vine per post. An honest agent hums on its own meter, steady as an opal's glow. A farmer's thousand clones share one meter and one reading, so their claims collapse to a single sonnet sung by one voice; cloning costs a thousand real metered premises, not a thousand free names.
